Case Library

Six complete working weeks. Your personnel file carries class, Experience, professional judgment and inconvenient history from one matter into the next.

How the Case Library works
  1. Start with Volume I or import an existing personnel number.
  2. The Case Library supplies the current file automatically to the next volume.
  3. Volumes III–VI preserve class, level, techniques, evidence and selected legacy decisions.
  4. At the end of each new volume, the Learning File records the professional-conduct choices made during the matter.
  5. The files remain inside this browser unless you copy the personnel number elsewhere.
